summary: Initial coordination policy: six swarm archetypes, interface agreement before parallel work, independent verification, serialized integration.

discovery.responsibility: Gather evidence, investigate requests, identify unknowns, and distinguish symptoms from underlying problems.
discovery.activate_when: The objective comes from requests or conversations whose underlying need is not yet established.

planning.responsibility: Define outcomes, compare approaches, establish interfaces, and create executable plans.
planning.activate_when: More than one task or owner is needed, or an interface must be agreed.

delivery.responsibility: Implement changes, produce artifacts, and resolve integration issues.
delivery.activate_when: Something has to be built or changed.

verification.responsibility: Reproduce claims, inspect artifacts, test acceptance criteria, and challenge unsupported conclusions.
verification.activate_when: A result has mandatory acceptance criteria.

evolution.responsibility: Analyze outcomes, develop improvement hypotheses, build candidates, and run experiments.
evolution.activate_when: Outcomes show a recurring problem and exploration budget is available.

reliability.responsibility: Recover stalled work, maintain useful memory, identify recurring failures, and preserve provenance.
reliability.activate_when: Always, at low cost: recovery is continuous and knowledge capture runs at mission end.
